name: 9101-batchdecode-qwen2moe57b-dp8
model: Qwen/Qwen2-57B-A14B-Instruct, bf16. ~114 GB of safetensors over 29 shards.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node, NVSwitch.
parallelism: TP=8, DP=8 with data-parallel attention enabled, EP=8, PP=1. Expert-dispatch backend left at the stock default. HAZARD: dp_size < tp_size, dp_size == 1, an all-to-all expert backend, or a dense-MLP TP size of 1 each give a materially different server that still starts and still reports healthy goodput, so confirm dp_size == ep_size == tp_size == 8 and DP attention off the running server, not off the command line.
architecture: Qwen2MoeForCausalLM, bf16, no quantization_config. 28 decoder layers, 64 routed experts at top-8 plus one shared expert, GQA with 28 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 1200 s safety cap. 1024 streams is 128 requests per data-parallel rank.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets and no prefix reuse: 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 generated tokens out, both fixed at exactly that (stdev 0, min == max). temperature 0.0. The prefix cache is off, so every request prefills its whole prompt cold.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a mixture-of-experts model, serving 1024 concurrent one-page prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine would
# then start, at rc=0, without something this item declares. host / port / served-model-name
# are not set here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2-57B-A14B-Instruct

# The three sizes must stay equal and must stay set, and no `--moe-a2a-backend` or
# `--moe-dense-tp-size 1` may be added: each variant still serves the model and still reports
# healthy goodput, which is what makes a slip here expensive rather than obvious.
tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
ep-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

disable-radix-cache: true

# 8192 is not the effective value: under DP attention the engine divides the chunk size by
# dp_size, so the server runs at 1024 tokens per rank.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# 160 is the ceiling of this engine's H100 capture ladder ([1,2,4,8] then 16..160 by 8). Under DP
# attention the captured size is the PER-RANK batch, so 160 covers up to 1280 total streams.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 160

# If the server will not start, change this.
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

random-seed: 0
